provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly soil_moisture (Root Zone Soil Wetness, fraction 0-1) for Mexicali Valley, Mexico, 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.

verdict.label: inconclusive
verdict.reason: The p-value is small (p = 0.0262), but this record is too autocorrelated for that p-value to count as evidence.
